principles: Modern CFA foundation is anchored to 3 January 1955 and the nationwide cup structure to 1956.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is gated to 2006+; its very large all-player estimate is not mechanically translated into professional or elite quality.
AFC grassroots Silver (2018), Gold (2024), Elite Youth two-star (2024) and three-star (2026) accreditations are time-gated development signals.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 is gated to 2023+ for professional-ecosystem context.
No FIFA ranking or tournament result is used as a calibration target; all dimensions remain below 9.0.
